release_notes:
Release 1.0.31 — coherent field styling and order-details popup for File & Server orders

Order forms
- Applied the same coherent theme styling to the File and Server order forms as the IMEI redesign: custom-field dropdowns now show a matching chevron, radio buttons render as selectable pills, and labels/inputs are consistent.

Order details
- Server order-details popup: custom-field Text Area values (e.g. long GSX / case-history reports) now preserve their line breaks instead of collapsing to one line.
- Credit history: the "+" order-details popup now works for every order type — it opens the matching detail view (IMEI, File or Server), not just IMEI.
